profile.headline: Software Engineer | Java, Shell Scripting, C/C++, SQL
profile.summary:
✌️ Detail-focused IT professional delivering high-quality software by performing in-depth testing functions, troubleshooting and resolving complex issues, and aligning features and functionality with defined requirements. 

🙌 I am a team player who could communicate and collaborate really well with coworkers within the team and from other divisions

 🙌 I am easy-going and always willing to help

💻 TECHNICAL & SPECIALIZED SKILLS:

➡ Languages: Java, Shell Scripting, C/C++, SQL

➡ OS: Linux, Unix (AIX, Solaris,  FreeBSD) & Windows

➡ Platforms: On-Premise, Docker, Cloud (IBM BlueMix)

➡ ETL: InforSphere Information Server, Data Stage, Information Analyzer

➡ Tools: Selenium, Jenkins Server, JProfiler, Git, Eclipse

➡ DataBase: DB2, Informix Dynamic Server

➡ Limited: Tcl/Tk, PHP, HTML,  NoSQL(Cloudant), Hive, Python

positions.title: Software Engineer, Data Connect Performance team
positions.description:
Work cross-functionally with technical teams to test and analyze performance of IBM Cloud Services, including Data Connect and Open Metadata Service (an internal cloud service) on IBM Bluemix (cloud platform). Execute, analyze, and report test results.

•	Improved performance of Open Metadata Services 90% by working closely with team of developers to define, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans, analyzing response times for various APIs. 

•	Developed and executed Selenium scripts for Data Connect UI performance testing on Firefox by gathering wide range of data points for UI response time for various operations, investigating and identifying performance bottlenecks.

•	Evaluated Data Connect performance impact of using NoSQL (Cloudant) instead of relational database (DB2), ensuring switch to Cloudant with minimal risk and up to 84% improvement.

•	Implemented automated test infrastructure for performance regression testing, reducing performance defects.

•	Analyzed Data Connect with Apache Spark cluster, uncovering performance issues, reporting to development team.

positions.title: Software Engineer, InfoSphere Information Server Performance team
positions.description:
Worked in a global organization to test, evaluate, and analyze performance of Information Server products. Gathered performance data points and system information such as throughput, CPU, and memory usage. Reported recommendation to stakeholders

•	Planned and executed performance test for a customer patch of InfoSphere Information Analyzer, concluding performance improved up to 63%.

•	Delivered MDM Stage performance evaluation for Information Server 11.3, recommending multiple improvements.

positions.title: Software Engineer, InfoSphere Information Server System Verification Test team
positions.description:
Worked in a global organization to test and verify functionality of Information Server products in stress mode.

•	Developed and executed stress tests and analyzed test results for Information Analyzer 8.1.2, 8.5, 8.7 and 9.1, validating quality of product line.

•	Executed and analyzed test results for Data Click 9.x and 10.0 to ensure product quality, verifying test data had been copied to various target data source, including DB2 and Hadoop (IBM BigInsights)

•	Engaged with DataStage customer to provide high-level support, understand business needs, turning customer experience around, and securing future work.

positions.title: software engineer
positions.description:
Ported Informix products from development platform to various UNIX platforms and Linux. Built, tested, debugged, and developed new features and enhancements.

•	Developed and ported Informix database server (7.x and 9.x), ClientSDK (2.0x), and Informix MaxConnect from Solaris to various Unix platforms such as AIX, Siemens, SCO, Unixware, and Linux, providing customers with access to Informix products on various operating systems.

•	Led 2 release of IBM IDS 9.21 fix pack, working with customer support to prioritize bug fix list, meeting quality standards and defined deadlines.
